description:
Send messages to an OpenRouter chat model and get a text reply. Supports provider routing, model suffixes (`:nitro` fastest, `:floor` cheapest, `:free` zero-cost, `:online` web search, `:exacto` tool accuracy), reasoning tokens, web search (`online: true`), and response caching.

Use when:
- You need text generation, Q&A, summarization, or multi-turn dialogue
- You want web-grounded answers (`online: true`)
- You already know the model id (or rely on the server default)

Do NOT use when:
- Input is a single image/audio/video file → use analyze_image / analyze_audio / analyze_video (dedicated wrappers)
- You need to create images, audio, or video → use generate_* / text_to_speech tools
- You only need to check if a model exists → use validate_model

Good examples:
- `{ "messages": [{ "role": "user", "content": "Explain recursion in one paragraph." }] }`
- `{ "model": "openai/gpt-4o:nitro", "messages": [...], "online": true }` for web search
- `{ "messages": [...], "include_reasoning": true }` for chain-of-thought models

Bad examples:
- `{ "messages": [] }` → INVALID_INPUT (empty array)
- `{ "image_path": "photo.jpg" }` → wrong tool; use analyze_image
- Putting file paths inside message content without a vision model configured

Fails when:
- INVALID_INPUT: messages array is empty
- UPSTREAM_REFUSED: credits, content policy, or rate limit
- UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT: upstream did not respond in time
- MODEL_NOT_FOUND: model slug does not exist on OpenRouter

Works with: validate_model, search_models.

cache.description: Enable OpenRouter response caching via `X-OpenRouter-Cache: true`. Server default: `OPENROUTER_CACHE_RESPONSES=1`.

cache_clear.description: Bust the cache entry for this exact request.

cache_ttl.description: Cache TTL as integer seconds (1–86400) or a duration string such as "30s", "5m", or "1h". Sent upstream as seconds.

include_reasoning.description: Surface the model's chain-of-thought on `_meta.reasoning` for R1 / Opus / Gemini Thinking models.

max_tokens.description: Max completion tokens. Falls back to `OPENROUTER_MAX_TOKENS` env var if unset.

model.description: Model ID (optional, uses server default). Append `:nitro` (fastest), `:floor` (cheapest), `:free`, `:online` (web search), or `:exacto` (tool accuracy). Example: `openai/gpt-4o:nitro`. Or pass `online: true` for programmatic web search.

provider.description: OpenRouter provider-routing overrides. Merges on top of `OPENROUTER_PROVIDER_*` env defaults. See https://openrouter.ai/docs/features/provider-routing

name: chat_completion
